proof:
:= by
  have h_main : n ∉ properUnitaryDivisors n := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
      have h₂ : n ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := h
      have h₃ : n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
        -- Prove that n is in the Finset.Ico 1 n using the definition of properUnitaryDivisors
        have h₄ : n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
          -- Use the fact that n is in properUnitaryDivisors n to get the required condition
          have h₅ : n ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := h₂
          have h₆ : n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
            -- Use the definition of properUnitaryDivisors to get the required condition
            simp [properUnitaryDivisors, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₅ ⊢
            <;> aesop
          exact h₆
        exact h₄
      exact h₃
    -- Derive a contradiction from the fact that n is in Finset.Ico 1 n
    have h₂ : n ∉ Finset.Ico 1 n := by
      -- Prove that n is not in Finset.Ico 1 n
      simp [Finset.mem_Ico]
      <;> omega
    exact h₂ h₁
  exact h_main
